selected_evidence.summary: Shows installation, the exact 02:15 cron entry, active cron service, correct file metadata, and successful appended output before and after restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 0256e3f5-9f2d-48f3-b55b-12f9f4d599ab; restart was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 58097fa1-ec02-48a0-938b-7a3ba9363e15; cron, schedule, executable, and retained log all recovered.
